chapterInfo.content:
5
Adwotwa ne ahonu frɛ
1Israel fie, montie asɛm yi a merema so mo ho a ɛyɛ kwadwom:
2Ababaa Israel atɔ,
ɔrensɔre bio,
wɔahwe no ase n’asase so,
deɛ ɔbɛma no soɔ nni hɔ.
3Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Kuro a wɔde apem firi adie
bɛka ɔha,
na kuro a wɔde ɔha firi adie
bɛka du
ama Israel fie.
4 # Yer 29.13 Na sɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛ Israel fie nie:
Monhwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan na monnya nkwa.
5 # Amos 4.4; Hos 4.15 Na monnhwehwɛ Betel akyiri kwan,
na monnkɔ Gilgal,
na monntwam nnkɔ Beer-seba;
ɛfiri sɛ Gilgal bɛgyina akɔ otukorɔ mu,
na Betel bɛdane huhuo.
6Monhwehwɛ AWURADE akyiri kwan na monnya nkwa,
na wampue sɛ ogya Yosef fie,
na wanhye a obi a ɔbɛdum nni hɔ mma Betel;
7 # Amos 6.12; Yes 5.20 mo a modane atemmuo bɔnwono
na mode tenenee hwehwe fam no!
8 # Hiob 38.31; Amos 9.6 Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ nsoromma a ebi ne Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma ne Nwenwenente,
na ɔdane esum kabii adekyeeɛ,
na ɔma awia duru sum sɛ anadwo,
ɔfrɛ ɛpo mu nsuo
hwie gu asase ani,
AWURADE ne ne din.
9Ɔma ɔsɛeɛ ba otumfoɔ so sɛ anyinam,
na ɔsɛeɛ nso ba aban a ɛyɛ den so.
10 # Yes 29.21 Wɔtane deɛ ɔtenetene, kuro pono mu,
na wɔkyiri deɛ ɔka nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
11 # Sef 1.13 Enti ɛnam sɛ motiatia mmɔborɔni soɔ
na mogye ne hɔ ayuo nti,
mode aboɔ a wɔatwa atoto aban,
nanso morentena mu,
moatɛ bobe nturo a ɛyɛ fɛ,
nanso morennom mu nsa.
12Na menim sɛ mo mmarato dɔɔso
na mo bɔne mu yɛ den.
Mohiahia ɔteneneeni ho na mogyegye mpata,
na mokyea ahiafoɔ asɛm kuro pono mu.
13Saa nti ɔba nimdefoɔ mua n’ano, ɛberɛ no mu,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ berɛ bɔne.
14Monhwehwɛ papa, na ɛnyɛ bɔne,
na moanya nkwa,
na AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn ne mo atena,
sɛdeɛ moka no.
15 # Dwom 34.15; Rom 12.9 Montane bɔne na monnɔ papa,
na momma atɛmpa ntim kuro apono mu;
ebia AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn
bɛhunu Yosef nkaeɛ no mmɔbɔ.
16Enti sɛ AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, AWURADE no seɛ nie:
Adwotwa wɔ mmɔntene nyinaa so,
na wɔka no mmorɔno nyinaa so sɛ: Buee, buee!
Na wɔfrɛ okuafoɔ ma no bɛsu,
ne wɔn a wɔnim su ma wɔbɛtwa agyaadwo.
17Na adwotwa wɔ bobe nturo nyinaa mu,
ɛfiri sɛ mɛsane mafa wo mu,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
18 # Yoel 2.11 Wɔnnue, wɔn a wɔfe AWURADE da no!
AWURADE da yi bɛyɛ mo dɛn?
Ɛyɛ esum, na ɛnyɛ hann.
19Ɛte sɛdeɛ obi dwane firi gyata anim
na osisire hyia no,
na ɔba efie na ɔde ne nsa twere ɔfasuo
na ɔwɔ ka no.
20AWURADE da no ɛnyɛ sum anaa? Ɛnyɛ hann!
Ɛnyɛ kusuu anaa? Ɛnhyerɛn!
21 # Yes 1.11-15 Metane na mepo mo nnapɔnna,
na m’ani nnye mo afahyɛ nhyiamu ho.
22 # Mika 6.6-7 Na sɛ mobɔ mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma me na mode mo aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛ me a,
m’ani rensɔ,
na mo nyɛmmoa asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nso,
merenhwɛ.
23Yi wo dwontoɔ gyegyeegyeyɛ firi me so,
na wo sankubɔ nso, merentie.
24Na atemmuo mmuni mmra sɛ nsuo,
na tenenee mmra sɛ asuo a ɛsene daa.
25 # Aso 7.42-43 Israel fie, mode okum afɔdeɛ ne aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ me ɛserɛ so mfirinhyia aduanan? 26Mmom mosoa mo hene Sikut ne mo ahoni Kiun no, mo nyame a moyɛ faeɛ no nsoromma. 27Enti mɛtu mo akɔ Damasko akyire nohoa, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, asafo Nyankopɔn ne ne din.

Israel fie, montie asɛm yi a merema so mo ho a ɛyɛ kwadwom:
Ababaa Israel atɔ,

Na sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Kuro a wɔde apem firi adie
bɛka ɔha,
na kuro a wɔde ɔha firi adie
bɛka du
ama Israel fie.

Na sɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛ Israel fie nie:
Monhwehwɛ m’akyiri kwan na monnya nkwa.
Na monnhwehwɛ Betel akyiri kwan,
na monnkɔ Gilgal,
na monntwam nnkɔ Beer-seba;

na Betel bɛdane huhuo.
Monhwehwɛ AWURADE akyiri kwan na monnya nkwa,
na wampue sɛ ogya Yosef fie,
na wanhye a obi a ɔbɛdum nni hɔ mma Betel;
mo a modane atemmuo bɔnwono
na mode tenenee hwehwe fam no!

Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ nsoromma a ebi ne Akokɔbaatan-ne-ne-mma ne Nwenwenente,
na ɔdane esum kabii adekyeeɛ,
na ɔma awia duru sum sɛ anadwo,
ɔfrɛ ɛpo mu nsuo
hwie gu asase ani,
AWURADE ne ne din.
Ɔma ɔsɛeɛ ba otumfoɔ so sɛ anyinam,
na ɔsɛeɛ nso ba aban a ɛyɛ den so.

Wɔtane deɛ ɔtenetene, kuro pono mu,
na wɔkyiri deɛ ɔka nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ.
Enti ɛnam sɛ motiatia mmɔborɔni soɔ
na mogye ne hɔ ayuo nti,
mode aboɔ a wɔatwa atoto aban,
nanso morentena mu,

nanso morennom mu nsa.
Na menim sɛ mo mmarato dɔɔso
na mo bɔne mu yɛ den.
Mohiahia ɔteneneeni ho na mogyegye mpata,
na mokyea ahiafoɔ asɛm kuro pono mu.
Saa nti ɔba nimdefoɔ mua n’ano, ɛberɛ no mu,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ berɛ bɔne.

Monhwehwɛ papa, na ɛnyɛ bɔne,
na moanya nkwa,
na AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn ne mo atena,
sɛdeɛ moka no.
Montane bɔne na monnɔ papa,
na momma atɛmpa ntim kuro apono mu;
ebia AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn
bɛhunu Yosef nkaeɛ no mmɔbɔ.

Enti sɛ AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, AWURADE no seɛ nie:
Adwotwa wɔ mmɔntene nyinaa so,
na wɔka no mmorɔno nyinaa so sɛ: Buee, buee!
Na wɔfrɛ okuafoɔ ma no bɛsu,
ne wɔn a wɔnim su ma wɔbɛtwa agyaadwo.
Na adwotwa wɔ bobe nturo nyinaa mu,
ɛfiri sɛ mɛsane mafa wo mu,
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

Wɔnnue, wɔn a wɔfe AWURADE da no!
AWURADE da yi bɛyɛ mo dɛn?
Ɛyɛ esum, na ɛnyɛ hann.
Ɛte sɛdeɛ obi dwane firi gyata anim
na osisire hyia no,
na ɔba efie na ɔde ne nsa twere ɔfasuo
na ɔwɔ ka no.
AWURADE da no ɛnyɛ sum anaa? Ɛnyɛ hann!
Ɛnyɛ kusuu anaa? Ɛnhyerɛn!

Metane na mepo mo nnapɔnna,
na m’ani nnye mo afahyɛ nhyiamu ho.
Na sɛ mobɔ mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma me na mode mo aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛ me a,
m’ani rensɔ,

merenhwɛ.
Yi wo dwontoɔ gyegyeegyeyɛ firi me so,
na wo sankubɔ nso, merentie.
Na atemmuo mmuni mmra sɛ nsuo,
na tenenee mmra sɛ asuo a ɛsene daa.

Israel fie, mode okum afɔdeɛ ne aduane ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ me ɛserɛ so mfirinhyia aduanan? Mmom mosoa mo hene Sikut ne mo ahoni Kiun no, mo nyame a moyɛ faeɛ no nsoromma. Enti mɛtu mo akɔ Damasko akyire nohoa, AWURADE na ɔseɛ, asafo Nyankopɔn ne ne din.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
